Updated for the Dungeon Settlers game update DS_B.0.4.29 (Steam build 25846389).
Requires Delvers Core 0.4.1. Update Core and Frieren together.
Fixed: Under BepInEx, Frieren 0.4.0 loaded only together with exactly Core 0.4.0 and stayed off with Core 0.4.1. Frieren now accepts Core 0.4.1 or later.
The start message in the log now names the game version checked by the installed Core.
Tested under BepInEx and MelonLoader on the new build, together with Extended Hotbar 1.0.2.
